text:
maya_sales: Heads-up: HelixBank is asking for SOC2 excerpt + signed external-scan attestation for their EU staging POC. Deadline Thu 10am CET. Also requested Dedicated EU pricing for predictable throughput and EU KMS.
cole_se: Copy. Who owns signing the attestation? @emma_security
emma_security: I can sign the external-scan attestation for POCs. We have an ISO/SOC2 redacted excerpt we share. Need customer legal contact and confirmation that diagrams are not required.
maya_sales: Contact is legal@helixbank.eu (Luca Marin). They explicitly said no internal diagrams for the POC, just attestation + excerpt.
ops_miguel: Dedicated with customer-managed KMS in eu-west-1 covers EU residency. Lead time for KMS + routing ~48 hours. Ballpark pricing: `dedicated-small: \u20ac7k/mo`, `kms-key: \u20ac180/mo`, `setup: \u20ac1.8k` (3-month commit reduces setup by 50%).
cole_se: Can we use an external vulnerability scan (Qualys/Detectify) instead of full pen-test? Procurement prefers that for POC.
emma_security: External scan + signed attestation is acceptable for POCs. I'll include a short clause: "External scan acceptable for POC; production may require fuller assessment."
legal-bot: files uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/SOC2_excerpt_redacted_Helix.pdf ; https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/external_scan_attestation_Helix.docx (links expire in 7 days)
maya_sales: Perfect. I'll send to Luca and ask about commit term. If they confirm 3 months, I'll request discounted setup. Will update here. :thumbsup:
